name: Team-5 Table Plot Agent
description: Extracts and publishes a table that can be plotted.

skills.name: Team-5 Table Extraction
skills.description: Find one table in an uploaded markdown document by matching the user's description against the table captions, parse it, and publish it as a table artifact with clean numeric columns.
skills.usage_notes: Use when the user refers to a table inside a markdown/text document. To plot the extracted table, pass the returned table_artifact_id to team_5_plot_table. Not for CSV files: those can be plotted directly.

table_description.description: How the user referred to the table, in their words, e.g. 'the table with population data'. Matched against the table captions by meaning.

skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, table_artifact_id, caption, columns, numeric_columns, row_count, why_this_table

skills.name: Team-5 Table Plot Analysis
skills.description: Plot one or more numeric Y columns against an X column as a PNG line, scatter, or grouped bar chart. Multiple series share one Y axis and have a legend. Works on an uploaded CSV file or on a table produced by team_5_extract_table. If the user names no columns, call it with only table_artifact_id: the skill asks, offering the real column names. Do not guess columns.
skills.usage_notes: Use for 'plot', 'chart', 'graph' requests on tabular data. For a table inside a markdown document, call team_5_extract_table first and pass its table_artifact_id here. Not for markdown documents directly. Column names may be approximate ('temperature').
skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, artifact_id, x_column, y_columns, kind, x_scale, y_scale; legacy y_column is the sole Y column for single-series plots and null for multiple series

table_artifact_id.description: Artifact ID of an uploaded CSV file, or the table_artifact_id returned by team_5_extract_table.

x_column.description: The name of the x axis, or the name of the column (approximate ok)

y_column.description: One numeric Y column, for compatibility with single-series requests. Use y_columns for multiple series.

y_columns.description: Numeric Y columns to plot, in legend order (exact names or unique substrings). Takes precedence over y_column. If omitted, the skill asks for a column using the real names.

title.description: Optional plot title. Defaults to readable selected column labels with units, in y vs x order. The source caption is preserved in artifact metadata.

x_scale.description: X axis scale; defaults to linear. Use log only when requested, with numeric, strictly positive x values.

y_scale.description: Y axis scale; defaults to linear. Use log for a requested logarithmic y axis with strictly positive values. For a log-log plot set both scales to log.

kind.description: Chart type. Use bar for comparisons across text categories on the x axis. Defaults to line when omitted.
